findings.location: Paragraph containing the quoted material attributed to “A Word From the Doctor”
findings.source_quote: He writes, “Jesus knows our limitations. He wants us to have balance, living in such a way that we not only have strength for today but also for tomorrow, next week, and next year – till He comes again.”
findings.suggested_fix: The quoted sentence is substantive quoted prose and must be translated into Dutch. Example fix: vervang the English quote with a faithful Dutch rendering while preserving the surrounding quotation marks and punctuation. Suggested translation: “Jezus kent onze grenzen. Hij wil dat we evenwicht hebben, zó leven dat we niet alleen kracht hebben voor vandaag, maar ook voor morgen, volgende week en volgend jaar — totdat Hij wederkomt.”
findings.translation_quote: In dit nummer leidt “A Word From the Doctor” ons terwijl we het doolhof van het leven betreden en geeft ons praktische en Bijbelse oplossingen om burn-out te voorkomen of ervan te herstellen. Hij schrijft: “Jesus knows our limitations. He wants us to have balance, living in such a way that we not only have strength for today but also for tomorrow, next week, and next year – till He comes again.”
